katie: quick flag from today's veridian-v2 q4-compact onboarding sweep. small cluster of locale regressions on srt/ruby/rtl slices (en->ja BLEU down ~4.2 on srt).

rafael: can you paste a tiny repro?

katie: JA sample (vertical subtitle):
SRC: 『退了』
REF: "He's left."
BASE (float): tokens [T10,T11,T12] -> "He's left."
Q4: tokens [T10,T12] -> "He's left"  <-- missing middle token; sometimes trailing fullwidth punctuation attached. seen ~60 similar cases.

katie: ZH ruby inline sample:
SRC: "漢字( pinyin )"
REF: "kanji (pinyin)"
BASE: "kanji (pinyin)"
Q4: "kanji(pinyin"  <-- closing paren merged to word, space gone. token ids differ.

rafael: any bidi examples?

katie: AR sample: SRC: "(هل تريد?)"
BASE pre-detok ids: [LP, AR_WORDS..., RP]
Q4 pre-detok ids: [RP, AR_WORDS..., LP]  <-- ordering flipped in decoded token sequence, not just rendering.

wei: thanks. quick isolation step: run float weights with q4-compact tokenizer and `--tokenize-only`. if that reproduces, it's tokenizer/merge-table.

haruto: also grep the compact generator for any recent changes touching punctuation classes or ZWJ/ZWSP handling; we had a "prune-joiners" tweak recently.

katie: ran float+q4-tokenizer: reproduces all three classes. enabling tokenizer guard `--protect-punct` preserves tokens and fixes ordering for AR sample. so root cause is generator/merge-table.

ci-bot: nightly-compact-run metadata: run_id=2026-08-20_02, samples=8000, flagged=73, top_flags=['ja-srt-punct','zh-ruby-glue','ar-bracket-bidi']

wei: plan: 1) bisect generator commits to find exact PR, 2) hotfix generator to enable punctuation protection in CJK/bidi ranges, 3) regen compact tables, run targeted smoke tests (srt, ruby, bidi), 4) add float+compact-tokenizer integration test in CI.

haruto: I'll land the hotfix to enable protect-punct by default and regen a small sample set.

katie: pausing veridian-v2 canary until regen + smoke pass. please add unit tests for vertical/ruby/bidi to quant-onboard.

wei: bisection narrowed to commit range prune-joiners/2026-08-05 .. 2026-08-12. reproducing locally.

haruto: hotfix 1a2b3c landed: protect-punct enabled for CJK+bidi ranges in generator. quick regen on subset shows flagged 73 -> 4 (non-blocking). scheduling full regen.

ci-bot: regen-complete 4971230120: flagged dropped 73 -> 4; regression severity: low; next: schedule comprehensive smoke before unpause.

katie: great work. follow-ups: GH issue with samples+token diffs, add tests to quant-onboard, and note in release playbook to run float+compact-tokenizer check pre-merge. tagging @haruto @wei. :thumbsup:
